source: {i}(It’s that time of the year again, huh?){/i}
translation: {i}（又到了一年中的这个时候啊。）{/i}

source: {i}(Camp Buddy’s off-season…){/i}
translation: {i}（Camp Buddy 的休营期……）{/i}

source: {i}(It’s not really my favorite part of the year, but it has to happen eventually… It’s always so lonely to see the camp so quiet and empty…){/i}
translation: {i}（我其实不太喜欢一年里的这段时间，但它终究还是会到来……看到营地变得这么安静、空荡，总让人觉得很寂寞……）{/i}

source: {i}(There's no campers around like there used to be… And that means no activities either…){/i}
translation: {i}（这里不再像以前那样到处都是营员了……也就没有任何活动了……）{/i}

source: {i}(But… this time is different than the previous years.){/i}
translation: {i}（不过……今年和往年不一样。）{/i}

source: {i}(Now that the camp has become successful and popular, the next term will be busier than ever!){/i}
translation: {i}（如今营地经营得很成功，人气也越来越高，下个营期一定会比以往更加忙碌！）{/i}

source: {i}(I guess that’s something I can look forward to! I’m happy that Camp Buddy is back at its peak!){/i}
translation: {i}（这倒是很值得期待！Camp Buddy 能重回巅峰，我真的很开心！）{/i}

source: Anyway, since you weren’t listening to me, I was asking when you’ll be done cleaning up here?
translation: 总之，既然你刚才没听我说话，我再问一遍：你什么时候能把这里收拾完？

source: I need some firewood for the office since the air is getting a little chilly now.
translation: 天气开始有点冷了，办公室里需要一些柴火。

source: Oh, I just finished here, so I can chop some right away!
translation: 哦，我这里刚忙完，马上就能去劈柴！

source: Let me go find Aiden and we'll get it done for you faster!
translation: 我去找Aiden一起帮忙，这样很快就能弄好！

source: I doubt he’ll be able to help anytime soon. I just saw Aiden busy with some other chores, so I didn’t bother asking him.
translation: 他恐怕暂时帮不上忙。我刚看到Aiden还在忙别的杂活，所以就没去问他。

source: If you want, I can help you instead! I know how to swing an axe around too, after all~
translation: 你要是愿意，我可以来帮你！毕竟我也会抡斧头嘛～

source: Haha, it’s alright, Yuri. I can manage!
translation: 哈哈，没关系，Yuri。我一个人能行！

source: Besides, don’t you have work to do with Sir Goro as well?
translation: 而且，你不是也要和Goro先生一起工作吗？

source: *sigh* Don't remind me… I don't know how Dad can stand to keep working  in his office like that all day long – it drives me crazy!
translation: *叹气* 别提了……真不知道爸爸怎么受得了整天窝在办公室里工作——我都快疯了！

source: Honestly, coming out here to check on you was just an excuse to stretch my legs and get some fresh air!
translation: 说实话，我出来看看你只是想找个借口活动一下腿脚，顺便呼吸点新鲜空气！

source: I guess it can't be helped, Yuri. There's been a ton of legal paperwork for Sir Goro to work on ever since the last term ended.
translation: 这也没办法，Yuri。上个营期结束后，Goro先生就有一大堆法律文件要处理。

source: There's so much stuff to do just to keep the place running with only the few of us and almost all the scouts gone.
translation: 现在几乎所有童军都走了，只靠我们这几个人维持营地运转，要做的事情实在太多了。

source: Is that what you were daydreaming about before?
translation: 你刚才发呆就是在想这些吗？

source: I was just thinking about how much Camp Buddy has changed over the years…
translation: 我只是在想，这些年来 Camp Buddy 真的改变了很多……

source: It’s been a roller-coaster ride, huh…?
translation: 一路走来真是跌宕起伏，对吧……？

source: Yeah… I really got the chance to connect with the campers as well… It's probably the greatest term I've ever had.
translation: 是啊……我也真正有机会和营员们建立了深厚的联系……那大概是我经历过最棒的一个营期。

source: It does make me wonder how many of them will come back next year.
translation: 不知道明年他们当中会有多少人回来。

source: Aww, you really do miss them a lot, don't you?
translation: 哎呀，你真的很想念他们，对吧？

source: I’m sure a lot of them will come back! And if not, that’s okay too!
translation: 我相信很多人都会回来的！就算有人不回来，也没关系！

source: Yeah, but I have to be honest… It'll be really sad if I never see some of those campers again.
translation: 是啊，但说实话……如果以后再也见不到其中一些营员，我一定会很难过。

source: Hey, lighten up a bit, will you? I expected you to be less of a worrywart now that everything is going well.
translation: 嘿，放轻松点，好吗？现在一切都很顺利，我还以为你不会再这么爱操心了。

source: The next term is still months away and a lot can happen in their personal lives.
translation: 离下个营期还有好几个月，他们各自的生活中可能会发生很多事。

source: You did your job last summer, and whether they come back or not is up to them.
translation: 去年夏天你已经尽到了自己的职责，至于他们回不回来，要由他们自己决定。

source: But one thing is certain, we all had some of our greatest memories here at Camp Buddy last term…
translation: 但有一件事可以肯定：上个营期，我们都在 Camp Buddy 留下了最美好的回忆……

source: And that’s something that will forever stay in our hearts!
translation: 这些回忆会永远留在我们心里！

source: Haha… Now who’s the sentimental one?
translation: 哈哈……现在到底是谁多愁善感了？

source: *pulls Yoshinori’s ear*
translation: *揪住Yoshinori的耳朵*

source: O-Ow!
translation: 疼、疼！

source: Hmph! All I’m saying is, you can cherish the past, but it’s best to focus on what’s ahead!
translation: 哼！我只是想说，你可以珍惜过去，但最好还是把注意力放在未来！

source: You’re right, Yuri.
translation: 你说得对，Yuri。

source: Anyways! Those logs aren’t gonna split themselves, Yoshi! I better see a fresh pile of wood chopped by sundown!
translation: 总之！那些木头可不会自己裂开，Yoshi！太阳下山前，我要看到一堆新劈好的柴！

source: I’ll be around the shed if you need me~!
translation: 需要我的话，我就在工具棚附近哦～！

source: H-Hey! I thought you were helping your dad…!
translation: 等、等等！你不是要去帮你爸爸吗……！

source: Oh, he’ll be fine without me for a while! Hihihi~!
translation: 哦，我暂时不在他也没问题！嘻嘻嘻～！

source: *sigh*
translation: *叹气*

source: Brr… It’s really cold out here… I better get moving.
translation: 好冷……外面真的太冷了……我得赶紧动起来。

source: H-Huh…? Is someone already here?
translation: 咦、咦……？已经有人在这里了吗？

source: Oh, Aiden…!
translation: 哦，是Aiden……！

source: Hey there, Yoshi!
translation: 嗨，Yoshi！

source: I was just chopping some wood over here. You need anything?
translation: 我刚才在这里劈柴。你需要什么吗？

source: Ah, I was about to gather some myself to bring to the office.
translation: 啊，我正准备收集一些送到办公室去。

source: Here, come and get some! I made plenty!
translation: 来，拿一些去吧！我劈了很多！

source: I figured we would be using a lot more now that the weather's getting colder.
translation: 我想天气越来越冷，我们接下来会用掉更多柴火。

source: And I knew Yuri was gonna ask you to do it, so I thought I'd take it off your list!
translation: 而且我知道Yuri会叫你来做，所以就想替你把这项任务解决掉！

source: Aiden… You didn’t have to do that.
translation: Aiden……你其实不用这样做的。

source: Oh, come on! It’s fine! I always like to smack some wood and work my muscles up!
translation: 哎呀，没事啦！我一直都很喜欢劈木头，顺便锻炼肌肉！

source: Well, I was going to ask for your help anyway, but Yuri told me you were busy with other chores.
translation: 其实我本来也打算请你帮忙，但Yuri说你还在忙别的杂活。

source: I was, but I already prepped everything and left our dinner cooking in the oven.
translation: 刚才确实在忙，不过我已经把东西都准备好，也把晚餐放进烤箱里烤着了。

source: And I used up all the firewood in the kitchen, so I needed to make some more anyways!
translation: 而且厨房里的柴火都被我用完了，反正也得再劈一些！

source: Haha, it looks like you've got everything covered, huh?
translation: 哈哈，看来一切都被你安排妥当了，对吧？

source: Yup! You know you can always count on me!
translation: 没错！你知道我一直都靠得住！

source: You should give yourself a break sometimes though, Aiden. I mean… you really haven't stopped doing chores even after the summer term ended.
translation: 不过你偶尔也该让自己休息一下，Aiden。我是说……就连夏季营期结束后，你也一直没有停下手里的杂活。

source: Don't worry, there's not that much stuff to do now that it's off-season. I only have to feed what, like... six people?
translation: 别担心，休营期没多少事情要做。我只需要给……大概六个人做饭？

source: Other than that, it’s just the usual stuff around the camp too, nothing I can’t handle!
translation: 除此之外，也就是营地里的日常工作，没有什么是我应付不了的！

source: Haha, I guess I shouldn't have expected any different. You've been taking care of everyone here for as long as I can remember, after all.
translation: 哈哈，我早该想到你会这么说。毕竟从我记事起，你就一直在照顾这里的每个人。

source: It’s my pleasure, Yoshi! Always at your service!
translation: 这是我的荣幸，Yoshi！随时为你效劳！

source: Hmm… As grateful as I am that you're always so willing to help, we should really get more staff around here for next year's term.
translation: 嗯……虽然我很感激你总是愿意帮忙，但为了明年的营期，我们确实应该多招一些员工。

source: Especially since we're expecting so many new recruits. We don't want you getting swamped with work like the past few terms!
translation: 特别是我们预计会有很多新成员。不能再像前几个营期那样，让工作把你彻底淹没！

source: It’s really not that big of a deal! They’re just chores after all!
translation: 真的没什么大不了的！毕竟只是些杂活！

source: Well, now that you're a scoutmaster just like me, I'm sure you could use a helping hand!
translation: 不过现在你和我一样也是童军团长了，肯定也需要有人搭把手！

source: W-Well, if you put it that way, I guess so.
translation: 这、这么说的话，好像也是。

source: Speaking of which, why don't you let me help you finish up here? I brought an axe with me anyway!
translation: 说起来，不如让我帮你把这里的活干完吧？反正我也带了斧头！

source: Haha, I wouldn't say no to some company~! You'll probably enjoy working up a sweat after all those boring tasks you've been doing!
translation: 哈哈，有人陪我当然不会拒绝～！做了那么多无聊的工作后，痛快出身汗，你肯定也会喜欢！

source: R-Right… Is that why you don’t have a shirt on? Aren't you cold?
translation: 是、是啊……所以你才没穿上衣吗？不冷吗？

source: Oho~ Distracted by my bod, are you?
translation: 哦嚯～被我的身材吸引得分心了，是吗？

source: Hahaha! You’re red as a tomato, Yoshi!
translation: 哈哈哈！你的脸红得像番茄一样，Yoshi！

source: I-I guess you’re right, hahaha…
translation: 我、我想你说得对，哈哈哈……

source: Now let’s get to work!
translation: 现在开始干活吧！

source: Excuse me for coming in without knocking, sir! I have the firewood right h—
translation: 抱歉没敲门就进来了，先生！柴火就在这——

source: Ah…! I hope I'm not disturbing you, Sir Goro!
translation: 啊……！希望我没有打扰您，Goro先生！

source: No, not at all, Yoshinori.
translation: 不，完全没有，Yoshinori。

source: Let me put these by the fireplace and I'll head out!
translation: 我把这些放到壁炉旁边就出去！

source: Ah, thank you, Yoshinori. Take your time though, it’s really alright.
translation: 啊，谢谢你，Yoshinori。不用着急，真的没关系。

source: {i}(Sir Goro looks busy as always… I can't imagine how stressful it must be to have so many responsibilities as the camp president.){/i}
translation: {i}（Goro先生还是一如既往地忙……身为营地负责人，肩负这么多责任，压力一定大得难以想象。）{/i}

source: I assume Yuri fetched you?
translation: 是Yuri叫你来的吧？

source: Yes, sir! She also mentioned having work to do in the shed.
translation: 是的，先生！她还说工具棚里有些工作要做。

source: *sigh* She’s trying to avoid all the admin tasks again, I see.
translation: *叹气* 看来她又想逃避所有行政工作。

source: Is there anything I can help with, sir?
translation: 有什么是我能帮忙的吗，先生？

source: It’s fine, Yoshinori. I can handle it.
translation: 没关系，Yoshinori。我能处理。

source: Actually, I was hoping to help you three with chores around the camp instead of all this legal work.
translation: 其实，比起处理这些法律事务，我更希望能和你们三个一起做营地里的杂活。

source: You have been working nonstop on paperwork since the last term ended. I was hoping to be able to assist you with it some.
translation: 从上个营期结束起，您就一直不停地处理文件。我希望自己多少能帮上一些忙。

source: Well, I'm trying to make sure we have everything arranged properly with Mr. Clermont. It's the least I could do, considering his company is sponsoring our camp.
translation: 这个嘛，我正努力确保与Clermont先生有关的一切都安排妥当。既然他的公司在赞助我们的营地，这至少是我该做的。

source: You're already doing a great deal just by managing the camp anyway. It makes me relieved to know that you'll be the one to take my place here when the time comes.
translation: 不管怎样，单是管理营地，你就已经承担了很多工作。知道时机成熟后会由你接替我的位置，让我很安心。

source: That’s an honor to hear from you, sir…!
translation: 能听您这么说，是我的荣幸，先生……！

source: But… I also want to make up for all the previous years when I didn't manage Camp Buddy properly as its president.
translation: 不过……我也想弥补过去那些没能以营地负责人身份好好管理 Camp Buddy 的岁月。

source: I’m trying my best to show you all that I can work just as hard and that this is much more than a job to me.
translation: 我正在尽全力让你们看到，我也能同样努力工作，而且这对我来说远不只是一份职业。

source: I understand, sir!
translation: 我明白，先生！

source: Come on, Yoshinori. You don’t have to be so stiff and formal around me.
translation: 放松点，Yoshinori。在我面前不用这么拘谨、正式。

source: A-Ah…!
Although, I can understand why you and everyone else were intimidated by me, given how strict and uptight I'd been over the last couple of years…
translation: 不过，考虑到过去几年我一直那么严厉又古板，我能理解为什么你和其他人都会怕我……

source: I truly regret that my actions led you all to feel that way.
translation: 我的行为让你们产生那种感受，我真的很后悔。

source: That's why I'm so grateful that we got to spend so much time together and catch up with one another last summer.
translation: 所以我非常庆幸，去年夏天我们能花那么多时间相处，重新了解彼此。

source: You and the scouts from the previous term were the reason I got my passion back and remembered what we all dreamed for this place to be.
translation: 正是你和上个营期的童军们，让我重拾热情，想起我们曾梦想把这里建设成什么样子。

source: *ehem* Maybe I should take a break before I start turning to dust here in the office.
translation: *清嗓子* 也许我该休息一下，免得在办公室里直接化成灰。

source: Wh-Wha…
translation: 什、什么……

source: Hahaha! I figured Yuri and Aiden were right that I’m not getting any younger. Might as well laugh about it, don't you think?
translation: 哈哈哈！看来Yuri和Aiden说得对，我确实不再年轻了。既然如此，不如一笑置之，你说呢？

source: I disagree, sir! You don't look old at all, especially not to me!
translation: 我不同意，先生！您一点都不显老，至少在我眼里完全不是！

source: If you're trying to kiss up to me so that you'll be promoted to camp president, you'll have to try harder than that.
translation: 如果你想靠讨好我来晋升为营地负责人，那还得更努力一点。

source: I-I’m not, sir…! I really meant it!
translation: 我、我没有，先生……！我是真心这么说的！

source: I’m just kidding, Yoshinori! Take it easy!
translation: 我只是开玩笑，Yoshinori！放松点！

source: I… I guess it’s just unusual for me to see you making jokes again, sir. It’s been so long since I’ve seen you this cheerful.
translation: 我……我只是有些不习惯再次看到您开玩笑，先生。已经很久没见您这么开朗了。

source: Just like back in the “old” days, you mean?
translation: 你的意思是，就像“从前”那样？

source: Hahaha, exactly, sir! It’s a good thing though!
translation: 哈哈哈，正是，先生！不过这是件好事！

source: Well, I'm trying my best to not be such a grump. I want to show how much I enjoy being here at camp with you all.
translation: 这个嘛，我正在尽量不让自己那么暴躁。我想让你们知道，自己有多享受和大家一起待在营地。

source: We’re glad to have the “old” you back as well, sir!
translation: 我们也很高兴“从前”的您回来了，先生！

source: Okay, I take it back. It does sound weird if you’re the one calling me old.
translation: 好吧，我收回刚才的话。由你说我老，听起来确实很奇怪。

source: Hahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

source: Anyway, why don’t we go over to the shed and help Yuri with whatever she’s doing?
translation: 总之，我们去工具棚看看，帮Yuri做她手头的事吧？

source: A-Are you sure, sir? You already have plenty on your hands right now.
translation: 您、您确定吗，先生？您现在已经有很多事情要忙了。

source: It's alright. I want us to get rid of a lot of clutter before Mr. Clermont's ocular visit.
translation: 没关系。我希望能在Clermont先生实地视察前，清理掉大量杂物。

source: The shed has been overflowing for a while, so it's probably best we go through it and see what's worth keeping.
translation: 工具棚已经乱得塞不下东西有一阵子了，最好逐一整理，看看哪些值得保留。

source: Exactly. A general cleanup has been long overdue. There's a lot of things scattered all over the place.
translation: 正是。早就该来一次大扫除了，到处都散落着各种东西。

source: And with plenty of new campers next year, it will be hard to monitor them all. The excess junk could be a hazard.
translation: 而且明年会有很多新营员，很难时刻照看所有人。多余的杂物可能造成安全隐患。

source: Anyway, thank you again for your concern, Yoshinori. Why don’t we go and join Yuri?
translation: 总之，再次谢谢你的关心，Yoshinori。我们去和Yuri会合吧？

source: Yes, sir!
translation: 是，先生！

source: Hnnnnnnghhh…!!
translation: 嗯啊啊啊……！！

source: Whew! That’s one crate out of thirty…
translation: 呼！三十个箱子，总算搬完一个……

source: Whoa, whoa, whoa. What are you trying to do here, Yuri?
translation: 喂、喂、喂。Yuri，你在这里想干什么？

source: Oh, umm… Well, you see, I figured I'd work on clearing out the shed since I overheard Dad on the phone talking about needing storage space.
translation: 哦，呃……这个嘛，我听见爸爸在电话里说需要储物空间，就想着把工具棚清理出来。

source: Why didn’t you ask any of us for help? I mean… that's a lot of lifting for just one person, you know.
translation: 你为什么不找我们帮忙？我是说……这么多东西，一个人搬可太累了。

source: Hmph! I’m a lot stronger than I look, Aiden.
translation: 哼！Aiden，我可比看起来强壮得多。

source: Besides, you guys are all so busy already.
translation: 况且你们都已经很忙了。

source: Well, there's no way I'll let you lift all these crates by yourself. You could get hurt!
translation: 我绝不可能让你一个人搬完这些箱子。你会受伤的！

source: *sigh* Fine. I was just trying to cut you some slack, you know.
translation: *叹气* 好吧。我只是想让你轻松一点。

source: Haha, don't worry about me – this is really the least I can do after all.
translation: 哈哈，别担心我——毕竟这只是我能做的最起码的事情。

source: Yoshi and Gramps are doing the big, important work to actually help the camp, so I don't mind taking on the simple tasks.
translation: Yoshi和Gramps在做真正能帮助营地的重要工作，所以我不介意承担这些简单任务。

source: You practically do the most work out of all of us! And whether they're simple or not doesn't matter, they're just as important!
translation: 我们所有人里，实际上就数你做的工作最多！而且简不简单根本不重要，它们同样重要！

source: Give yourself a little more credit, Aiden! You’re a scoutmaster too, just like us!
translation: 多肯定一下自己吧，Aiden！你和我们一样也是童军团长！

source: It’s just… I can’t help but think everyone else has changed for the better except me, you know?
translation: 只是……我总忍不住觉得，除了我以外，其他人都变得更好了，你懂吗？

source: I mean… Gramps has loosened up a lot ever since the last term, and Yoshi isn’t such a worrywart anymore.
translation: 我是说……上个营期以后，Gramps放松了很多，Yoshi也不像以前那么爱操心了。

source: That’s not true, Aiden. You’ve seen my dad lately – he’s been in his office chair so much. I wouldn’t be surprised if his butt was glued to it!
translation: 才不是呢，Aiden。你也见过我爸爸最近的样子——他整天坐在办公室的椅子上。就算他的屁股粘在上面，我都不会觉得奇怪！

source: And Yoshi? I walked up to him staring up at the sky earlier, lost in his thoughts again!
translation: 再说Yoshi？我刚才走到他身边时，他又望着天空想事情想得出神！

source: My point is, don’t be so hard on yourself! It’s so not you to be thinking like this!
translation: 我的意思是，别对自己这么苛刻！这样胡思乱想一点都不像你！

source: Ahehe, I guess I do sound a bit sulky saying all that, eh?
translation: 啊哈哈，这么说起来，我听着确实有点闷闷不乐，对吧？

source: We’re here, Yuri!
translation: 我们来了，Yuri！

source: …Oh! Aiden, you’re here too!
translation: ……哦！Aiden，你也在这里！

source: Hey there, Yoshi and Gramps! I just happened to walk by and saw Yuri trying to empty the shed all by herself.
translation: 嗨，Yoshi、Gramps！我刚好路过，看见Yuri想一个人把工具棚搬空。

source: Ugh, great… Now everyone’s here.
translation: 唉，太好了……现在所有人都到齐了。

source: Yuri-dear, you should’ve waited for us so we could help.
translation: 亲爱的Yuri，你应该等我们来帮忙。

source: I’m pretty surprised to see you out of the office to begin with, Gramps. Thought you were swamped with Clermont mumbo-jumbo?
translation: 说起来，Gramps，看到你走出办公室还真让我吃惊。你不是被Clermont那些乱七八糟的事忙得不可开交吗？

source: Well, aren’t you overworked yourself, Aiden?
translation: 这个嘛，你自己不也工作过度了吗，Aiden？

source: Psshhh. I’m fine!
translation: 噗。我没事！

source: Anyway, why don’t you all leave this to me? I could use a workout after sitting all day.
translation: 总之，你们把这些都交给我吧。坐了一整天，我正好需要活动一下。

source: Since we’re all here, why don’t we work on it together, sir?
translation: 既然大家都在，不如一起干吧，先生？

source: Aww~ Everyone’s looking out for each other, just like the good ol’ days~
translation: 哎呀～大家都在互相关照，就像从前的美好时光一样～

source: *ehem* Should we get started while there’s still a little bit of sun? It’ll be unbearably cold later.
translation: *清嗓子* 趁太阳还没完全下山，我们开始吧？再晚些会冷得受不了。

source: Gee, Yuri, what is in all of these boxes?! They weigh a ton!
translation: 天啊，Yuri，这些箱子里到底装了什么？！重得要命！

source: I-It’s just some stuff I like to keep around~ Hihi~
translation: 只、只是些我喜欢留着的东西～嘻嘻～

source: I didn’t realize that most of the stuff in the shed belonged to you… I thought it was full of tools or something…
translation: 我都不知道工具棚里大部分东西是你的……我还以为里面全是工具之类的……

source: W-Well… they are tools… in a way.
translation: 这、这个嘛……从某种意义上说，它们也是工具……

source: Uhh… I have a small box here that says \“Don’t Touch\”…?
translation: 呃……我这里有个小箱子，上面写着\“不要碰\”……？

source: So, don’t touch it, thank you!
translation: 所以不要碰，谢谢！

source: Uhh… What was in there? Are you keeping dangerous items at camp?
translation: 呃……里面装了什么？你在营地里存放危险物品吗？

source: Well, it depends on how you use them~!
translation: 这个嘛，要看你怎么使用它们～！

source: I-I’m not going to pry further… I feel like I’ll regret asking.
translation: 我、我还是不继续追问了……总觉得问下去会后悔。

source: It seems like most of the boxes we opened out here so far just have random items in them.
translation: 到目前为止，我们在这里打开的大多数箱子，里面好像都只是些杂七杂八的东西。

source: Growing up, Yuri did have a hard time letting go of stuff she found interesting. Whenever she started a hobby, she would obsess over it.
translation: Yuri从小就很难丢掉自己觉得有趣的东西。每当开始一种爱好，她都会沉迷其中。

source: Excuse me?! You’re the last person I wanna hear that from! Hmph!
translation: 你说什么？！我最不想从你嘴里听到这种话！哼！

source: You’re the one who never lets go of stuff!
translation: 你才是那个什么都舍不得丢的人！

source: Hahaha, I guess that’s true. I do have quite a lot of  art and literature in my collection.
translation: 哈哈哈，好像确实如此。我的艺术品和文学藏品的确相当多。

source: Why are you keeping all of this in the shed anyway? Why not in your room or something?
translation: 话说回来，你为什么把这些全放在工具棚？为什么不放在自己的房间之类的地方？

source: My room is kinda full… so I had to put them somewhere…
translation: 我的房间有点满了……所以只能另找地方放……

source: Oh…
Now why are you two giving me that look?!
translation: 你们两个为什么用那种眼神看我？！

source: Hmph! This is why I was trying to do this on my own!
translation: 哼！所以我才想一个人整理！

source: Okay, Yuri! This is the last box with your name on it in there.
translation: 好了，Yuri！这是里面最后一个写着你名字的箱子。

source: I swept the shed spotless too. Never realized there was so much space in there without all this stuff!
translation: 工具棚也被我打扫得一尘不染。没了这些东西，真没想到里面有这么大空间！

source: Thank you guys for your hard work! I really appreciate it.
translation: 谢谢大家辛苦帮忙！我真的非常感激。

source: I can take it from here and sort out the things I want to keep.
translation: 接下来交给我吧，我会把想留下的东西整理出来。

source: Alright! Then if you two don't mind, I could use some big muscles to sort the other stuff.
translation: 好！那么你们两个要是不介意，我正需要几双有力的手臂来整理其他东西。

source: There's a few old tools that sorely need replacing, and we have some rusted and broken stuff we need to dispose of too.
translation: 有几件旧工具早该更换了，还有些生锈、损坏的东西需要处理掉。

source: Sure, Aiden!
translation: 当然，Aiden！

source: Hmm, okay, let’s see…
translation: 嗯，好，让我看看……

source: *gasp*
translation: *倒吸一口气*

source: OMG!!!!
translation: 我的天啊！！！！

source: What happened?!
translation: 发生什么事了？！

source: You guys won’t believe what I just found!!
translation: 你们绝对不敢相信我刚发现了什么！！

source: Yuri… You’re going to give me a heart attack. I thought you hurt yourself or something…
translation: Yuri……你快把我吓出心脏病了。我还以为你受伤了……

source: You don’t understand! I’ve been looking for this old thing for ages! I can’t believe it was in the shed all these years!
translation: 你们不明白！我找这个旧东西找了好多年！真不敢相信它这些年一直在工具棚里！

source: What is it anyways…? Kinda looks like an ancient book witches use to cast spells.
translation: 话说这到底是什么……？看起来有点像女巫用来施法的古书。

source: Aiden! I can’t believe you don’t know what this is! We used to write in this book when we were younger, remember?
translation: Aiden！真不敢相信你不知道这是什么！我们小时候经常在这本书里写东西，记得吗？

source: OH! I recognize that book!
translation: 哦！我认得那本书！

source: Isn’t that your journal, Yuri?!
translation: 那不是你的日记吗，Yuri？！

source: Yes! Oh, I’m so glad you remember it, Yoshi.
translation: 是啊！哦，真高兴你还记得它，Yoshi。

source: Sheesh… I honestly forgot that thing existed… I think the last time I saw it was when we were still scouts!
translation: 天啊……我都忘了还有这东西……上次见到它时，我们好像还是童军！

source: It’s looking a little rough, too… Are those water stains all over it?
translation: 它看起来也有些破旧……上面那些全是水渍吗？

source: Yeah… the box it was in must have gotten wet somehow… But it’s still readable for the most part!!
translation: 是啊……装它的箱子不知道怎么进了水……不过大部分内容还是能看的！！

source: I don’t think I’ve seen this journal of yours before…
translation: 我好像从没见过你的这本日记……

source: Yeah, because you were a busy scoutmaster back then.
translation: 是啊，因为你当时是个忙碌的童军团长。

source: This is where I used to put all my favorite memories with you guys! It was so much fun to write about what we were up to.
translation: 我以前会把和你们一起经历的所有珍贵回忆写在这里！记录大家做过的事情特别有趣。

source: I really, really wanted to show this to last year’s scouts and give them a little history of the camp…
translation: 我真的特别想把它拿给去年的童军们看，让他们了解一点营地的历史……

source: But I couldn’t because I thought this thing was lost forever.
translation: 可我一直以为它永远丢了，所以没能做到。

source: Is that why you gave a journal just like this to some of the scouts when they first arrived at camp?
translation: 所以有些童军初到营地时，你才送给他们一本这样的日记吗？

source: Yeah~! It was so wonderful to be able to write down memories, and I wanted them to be able to experience that as well!
translation: 没错～！能把回忆记录下来是一件特别美好的事，我也想让他们体验这种感觉！

source: You guys know I've always had a passion for writing, even when I was younger. I thought it would be great to share that with the scouts, so they'd be able to look fondly back on their experiences here one day!
translation: 你们知道，我从小就热爱写作。我觉得把这份热爱分享给童军们会很棒，这样终有一天，他们也能满怀温情地回顾在这里的经历！

source: I made it my personal tradition to offer a journal when I see scouts full of inspiration, such as Mr. Akatora and Mr. Nagame!
translation: 每当看到充满创作灵感的童军，我都会送他一本日记，这已经成了我的个人传统，比如Akatora先生和Nagame先生！

source: Oh, come on, you just look at their application forms and see who wrote “writing” as their hobbies.
translation: 得了吧，你只是查看申请表，看看谁在爱好一栏写了“写作”。

source: Hmph, not at all, Aiden!
translation: 哼，才不是呢，Aiden！

source: Now I’m actually curious what the camp was like back then from the eyes of a scout…
translation: 现在我倒真想知道，当时的童军眼中，营地是什么样子……

source: Alright, let’s take a peek then, shall we?
translation: 好，那我们就看一看吧？

source: Kyaaaa!!! Look at this, you guys~!!
translation: 呀啊啊！！！大家快看这个～！！

source: {i}(This is… our first picture together!){/i}
translation: {i}（这是……我们的第一张合照！）{/i}

source: {i}(Seeing it makes me remember what happened on that day so clearly…){/i}
translation: {i}（看到它，那天发生的一切又如此清晰地浮现在脑海中……）{/i}

source: Come on, guys! Hurry up! We have to take a picture on a special day like this!
translation: 快点，大家！抓紧时间！这么特别的日子，我们一定要拍张照片！

source: Y-Yuri! C-Can you move a little?! You’re stepping on my foot!
translation: 尤、Yuri！你、你能挪一下吗？！你踩到我的脚了！

source: Mr. Andre, I think it would be better if you were in the shot too!
translation: Andre先生，我觉得您也一起入镜会更好！

source: After all, this is Aiden’s first official day as a helper here!
translation: 毕竟今天是Aiden正式成为这里帮手的第一天！

source: It’s fine! I’ll take the picture; this is your moment after all!
translation: 没关系！我来拍照；毕竟这是属于你们的时刻！

source: Congratulations on finally being a part of Camp Buddy, Aiden!
translation: 恭喜你终于成为 Camp Buddy 的一员，Aiden！

source: I wish you were a scout too, but this works just as well! As long as we get to hang out and have fun together!
translation: 虽然我希望你也能成为童军，不过这样也一样好！只要我们能一起相处、一起玩得开心！

source: Hehe, it’s all thanks to you, Yoshi! You’ve been vouching for me since day one!
translation: 嘿嘿，这都多亏了你，Yoshi！从第一天起，你就一直替我说好话！

source: Nah, you’re the one who proved yourself here! You’ve been super helpful around the camp!
translation: 才不是，是你自己在这里证明了能力！你为营地帮了特别多忙！

source: Still, it wouldn’t have happened if you hadn’t been showing Sir Goro every little thing I was working on!
translation: 不过，要不是你把我做的每一件小事都告诉Goro先生，这件事也不会成真！

source: Haha, I guess it’s a team effort then!
translation: 哈哈，那就算是我们共同努力的成果吧！

source: Dad!!! Mom!!! What’s taking you so long?!
translation: 爸爸！！！妈妈！！！你们怎么这么久？！

source: A-Ah… Coming, dear!
translation: 啊、啊……来了，宝贝！

source: Vera, let’s settle this later, alright?
translation: Vera，我们以后再解决这件事，好吗？

source: Hmph. Fine.
translation: 哼。好吧。

source: Come on, join us in the pic—
translation: 来吧，和我们一起拍——

source: Let her be, Dad! Just come here already!
translation: 别管她了，爸爸！你快过来吧！

source: A-Ah, yes, of course
translation: 啊、啊，好的，当然。

source: Is everything alright, Sir Goro?
translation: 一切都还好吗，Goro先生？

source: Oh, haha! It’s nothing! My wife’s just a little tired, is all!
translation: 哦，哈哈！没什么！我妻子只是有点累了，仅此而已！

source: Alright, Mr. Andre! We’re ready!
translation: 好了，Andre先生！我们准备好了！

source: Okay, 3… 2… 1… Cheese!
translation: 好，三……二……一……茄子！

source: Wow, would you look at that! It’s already printing! That’s really cool.
translation: 哇，快看！已经开始出照片了！真酷。

source: Can I see? Can I see?!
translation: 让我看看？让我看看？！

source: Kyaa!! We look so cute here!
translation: 呀！！我们在照片里看起来好可爱！

source: If you want, I can frame it for you to hang inside the office, Yuri.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以把它装进相框，挂在办公室里，Yuri。

source: No way! This is gonna be in my album!
translation: 才不要！我要把它放进自己的相册！

source: Hahaha, of course.
translation: 哈哈哈，当然。

source: Anyway, a special day like this is worth a treat! I told Andre to whip us up one of his specials!
translation: 总之，这么特别的日子值得好好庆祝！我让Andre为我们做一道他的拿手菜！

source: Oh wow! Score!
translation: 哦，太棒了！走运！

source: Oh! So that's what you cooked that for, Dad!
translation: 哦！所以爸爸，你做那道菜是为了这个！

source: I’ll serve some up at the mess hall! Just follow me!
translation: 我会把菜端到食堂！跟我来吧！

source: Come on, Aiden! Let’s get it while it’s hot!
translation: 快点，Aiden！趁热去吃吧！

source: H-Hey, Y-Yuri…!
translation: 等、等等，尤、Yuri……！

source: Aren’t you coming, Sir Goro?
translation: 您不一起来吗，Goro先生？

source: I’ll catch up after a phone call. Please go ahead, Yoshinori.
translation: 我打完电话就过去。你先走吧，Yoshinori。

source: I’ll save some for you, sir!
translation: 我会给您留一些的，先生！

source: Hahaha, thank you!
translation: 哈哈哈，谢谢！

source: Seeya!
translation: 回头见！

source: Wow… We all look so different here…
translation: 哇……照片里的我们看起来都很不一样……

source: Hmm… When was this taken again?
translation: 嗯……这是什么时候拍的？

source: It’s around the time you got me my first camera, Dad~! Almost a decade ago, during Camp Buddy's first-ever term!
translation: 大概是爸爸给我买第一台相机的时候～！差不多十年前，Camp Buddy 的第一个营期！

source: Sheesh, I barely recognize myself there. Has it really been that long…?
translation: 天啊，我都快认不出照片里的自己了。真的已经过去那么久了吗……？

source: Seeing us like this feels so nostalgic… It really takes me back…
translation: 看到那时的我们，感觉真怀念……一下子把我带回了过去……

source: Hehehe~ How’d all your hair turn gray in less than a decade, Gramps?
translation: 嘿嘿嘿～Gramps，怎么不到十年，你的头发就全白了？

source: Hmph. Speak for yourself, Aiden. It’s hard to believe that a twig like you would bulk up in a couple years.
translation: 哼。先说说你自己吧，Aiden。很难相信你这样一根瘦竹竿，几年里竟然练得这么壮。

source: Talking about my glow-up, eh? I’ll take that as a compliment.
translation: 是在说我的华丽蜕变吗？那我就当成夸奖了。

source: Aww, but you and Yoshi looked so youthful with your skinny, twinky bodies! Not that I have complaints about your muscles now~
translation: 哎呀，可你和Yoshi当时瘦瘦的少年身材多青春啊！不过我对你们现在的肌肉也没有意见～

source: Time sure has flown by, hasn’t it?
translation: 时间过得真快，对吧？

source: Yeah, I miss being a scout – it was the happiest time of my life!
translation: 是啊，我很怀念当童军的日子——那是我一生中最快乐的时光！

source: *ehem* Anyway, why don’t we finish up here before you get too carried away, Yuri-dear?
translation: *清嗓子* 总之，亲爱的Yuri，在你兴奋过头之前，我们先把这里收拾完吧？

source: Actually… I got all the things I need from the shed. I’ll leave the cleanup to you guys~!
translation: 其实……我已经从工具棚里拿到了需要的东西。清理工作就交给你们啦～！

source: Eh? Where are you going?
translation: 咦？你要去哪儿？

source: I haven’t seen my journal in years! Let me have my moment!
translation: 我已经好多年没见到这本日记了！让我好好享受这一刻！

source: Though it’ll probably take me a while to read through all the entries…  I’ll let you guys know if there’s some cool stuff in here!
translation: 不过，要把所有内容读完大概得花些时间……如果里面有什么有趣的东西，我会告诉你们！

source: Byeeee~!
translation: 再见啦～！

source: *sigh* You really can’t stop her when she starts obsessing over something.
translation: *叹气* 她一旦对什么东西着迷，就真的没人拦得住。

source: Hahaha, what else is new?
translation: 哈哈哈，她不一直都这样吗？

source: Anyways, I think all we need to do is take the trash out, then we’re done here!
translation: 总之，我想只要把垃圾搬出去，这里的工作就完成了！

source: Why don’t you guys give me a hand, and I’ll treat you both to a beer?
translation: 你们来帮我一把，我请你们两个喝啤酒怎么样？

source: Sounds good to me. I could use a little stress relief after today. What do you say, Yoshinori?
translation: 听起来不错。忙了今天这么久，我正需要缓解一下压力。你觉得呢，Yoshinori？

source: A-Ah, yes! I’d be happy to join!
translation: 啊、好的！我很乐意一起！

source: Great! Let’s go then!
translation: 太好了！那我们走吧！

source: Thanks again for helping me with the chores, guys.
translation: 再次谢谢你们帮我做这些杂活。

source: It’s no problem, Aiden. I rarely get the chance to help.
translation: 没关系，Aiden。我很少有机会来帮忙。

source: You’ve pretty much kept our camp running over the years.
translation: 这些年来，几乎都是你在维持营地的日常运转。

source: Aww, Gramps… It’s always so nice to hear a compliment from you.
translation: 哎呀，Gramps……每次听你夸奖都让人特别开心。

source: H-Hey, I always give them out… when they’re due.
translation: 喂、喂，该夸奖的时候……我一直都会夸。

source: Hahaha, that's true, but it's hard to please you, Gramps! You only praise us once in a blue moon!
translation: 哈哈哈，这倒是真的，但要让你满意可不容易，Gramps！你难得才夸我们一次！

source: Well, I was telling Yoshinori earlier today how I’ve been trying to be more easygoing around you guys… especially after how I was the past few years.
translation: 这个嘛，我今天早些时候还对Yoshinori说，自己正努力在你们面前变得随和一些……特别是想到过去几年我的样子。

source: Don’t sweat it, Gramps. We know you just had plenty of management matters to deal with.
translation: 别放在心上，Gramps。我们知道你只是有太多管理事务要处理。

source: While I’m at it, thanks again for treating us to these nice cold drinks. It’s been a while since I’ve had a beer like this.
translation: 顺便也再次谢谢你请我们喝这么冰爽的饮料。我已经很久没喝过这样的啤酒了。

source: Shh, Gramps! Don’t be so obvious about it! We’re not supposed to have them in public!
translation: 嘘，Gramps！别说得这么明目张胆！我们不能在公共场所喝酒！

source: What?! I used to drink these outside all the time! When did that change?
translation: 什么？！我以前经常在外面喝！什么时候改的规定？

source: Sheesh, seriously? I thought you of all people would know the local rules!
translation: 天啊，真的吗？我还以为最了解当地规定的人肯定是你！

source: You knew about that too, right, Yoshi? You’ve been out drinking with me before!
translation: 你也知道这条规定，对吧，Yoshi？你以前和我一起在外面喝过酒！

source: Yoshinori?
translation: Yoshinori？

source: A-Ah! Sorry, what were you guys talking about?
translation: 啊、啊！抱歉，你们刚才在说什么？

source: Are you alright, Yoshinori? You seem to be spacing out again.
translation: 你还好吗，Yoshinori？你好像又走神了。

source: O-Oh, no, sir! I’m fine…!
translation: 哦、哦，不，先生！我没事……！

source: Come on, something’s definitely up! You’ve barely said anything ever since Yuri showed us that picture!
translation: 别装了，肯定有心事！从Yuri给我们看那张照片起，你几乎一句话都没说！

source: That’s true. Did it bring up a bad memory or something?
translation: 确实如此。那张照片让你想起什么不好的回忆了吗？

source: N-No, the opposite, actually! Seeing us all together back then made me think about all the things that happened in the past.
translation: 不、不是，其实恰恰相反！看到当时大家在一起的样子，让我想起了过去发生的所有事情。

source: Hmm? What do you mean exactly?
translation: 嗯？具体是什么意思？

source: Well… back then, Sir Goro was our scoutmaster, and we were the ones having a great summer at camp.
translation: 这个嘛……当时Goro先生是我们的童军团长，而我们是在营地享受美好夏日的童军。

source: …Thinking about how fun it was, it really made me want to relive those moments again.
translation: ……想到那时有多快乐，我真的很想再体验一次那些时刻。

source: I look back on those days fondly as well. Having scouts like you in the very first term really helped solidify my passion for Camp Buddy.
translation: 我也满怀温情地回顾那些日子。第一个营期就有你们这样的童军，确实坚定了我对 Camp Buddy 的热爱。

source: Hehe, those were some of our best memories together, after all.
translation: 呵呵，毕竟那是我们共同拥有的一些最美好回忆。

source: Yeah… but the thing is, I feel like I’ve forgotten what it’s like to enjoy myself without worrying about everything else.
translation: 是啊……但问题是，我好像已经忘了不操心其他事情、单纯享受快乐是什么感觉。

source: It made me realize that ever since I became a scoutmaster, I’ve been so single-mindedly focused on the present and future of Camp Buddy…
translation: 这让我意识到，自从成为童军团长以后，我一直只顾着 Camp Buddy 的现在和未来……

source: I think I’m partly to blame for that. The time I left you in charge on your own without proper guidance caused a far greater burden on you.
translation: 我想这也有我的一部分责任。当初没有给予适当指导，就把你一个人留下负责营地，给你带来了沉重得多的负担。

source: A-Ah, that’s not what I meant, sir!
translation: 啊、啊，我不是这个意思，先生！

source: Becoming a scoutmaster there has always been my dream. And now that I've achieved that goal, it makes me look back at why I wanted it in the first place.
translation: 成为这里的童军团长一直是我的梦想。如今实现了目标，我开始回想自己最初为什么会有这个梦想。

source: You know, Yoshinori, you were such a passionate and caring scout that you constantly inspired me to keep fighting for Camp Buddy.
translation: 你知道吗，Yoshinori，你曾是一个充满热情、关怀他人的童军，不断激励我继续为 Camp Buddy 奋斗。

source: I hope I can return the favor and help you enjoy your time at camp again.
translation: 我希望自己能回报你，帮助你重新享受在营地度过的时光。

source: Sir Goro…
translation: Goro先生……

source: Yeah, I miss the old Yoshi too! You were so cheerful and carefree back then, and now you spend so much of your time worrying!
translation: 是啊，我也很怀念以前的Yoshi！那时的你开朗又无忧无虑，现在却把那么多时间花在操心上！

source: We just gotta get you to stop overthinking things, hehe~
translation: 我们只需要让你别再想得太多，嘿嘿～

source: Well… I guess it’s mostly because I’ve been far less busy now that we’re in the off-season.
translation: 这个嘛……我想主要是因为进入休营期后，我没有以前那么忙了。

source: Normally, I’d use my time to think about what activities we’d be doing next, or how to improve everyone’s experiences at camp.
translation: 平时我会用这些时间思考接下来要开展什么活动，或者怎样改善每个人在营地的体验。

source: With the scouts gone, I don’t have as many responsibilities… and I guess that’s given me a lot of time to think about myself for once.
translation: 童军们离开后，我没有那么多责任要承担……这大概终于给了我很多时间思考自己。

source: Ah, I’m sorry you two have to hear me ramble about all this!
translation: 啊，抱歉让你们两个听我啰嗦这些！

source: No, no, it’s fine, Yoshi. You know we’re always here to listen and help you with whatever’s going through your head!
translation: 不、不，没关系，Yoshi。你知道，无论心里在想什么，我们都会在这里倾听并帮助你！

source: Exactly. We all have your back here, Yoshinori.
translation: 没错。Yoshinori，我们在这里都会支持你。

source: Th-Thank you both, really.
translation: 真、真的谢谢你们两个。

source: No problem, Yoshi~ But I think that’s enough of that cheesy talk! We’re having a drink to relax and have fun!
translation: 没问题，Yoshi～不过这些肉麻的话已经说够了！我们喝酒是为了放松和开心！

source: To be honest, I'm a little concerned about the authorities seeing us with these beers now.
translation: 说实话，我现在有点担心执法人员看到我们拿着这些啤酒。

source: Aww, come on, Gramps, live a little! What’s life if you don’t break the rules every once in a while?
translation: 哎呀，拜托，Gramps，偶尔放纵一下！如果从来不偶尔打破规则，人生还有什么意思？

source: Hahaha! Now this DOES feel like old times! You used to be such a troublemaker, Aiden.
translation: 哈哈哈！现在确实有从前的感觉了！Aiden，你以前可是个十足的惹事精。

source: Hey, I don’t think we ever got ourselves into anything serious! Right, Gramps?
translation: 嘿，我觉得我们从没惹出过什么严重麻烦！对吧，Gramps？

source: *sigh* I’m suddenly starting to worry about you as a scoutmaster, Aiden.
translation: *叹气* 我突然开始担心你能不能当好童军团长了，Aiden。

source: Don’t start acting like you two are so innocent! The three of us drank plenty during last summer term!
translation: 别装得好像你们两个那么无辜！去年夏季营期，我们三个可喝了不少！

source: With all the new scouts coming in next year, we’ll probably have to stop that. We don’t want a camper catching us, after all.
translation: 明年会有那么多新童军，我们大概得停止这样做。毕竟不能让营员撞见我们喝酒。

source: Haha, Yuri would be glad if we stopped. She’s always scolding us for drinking anyway.
translation: 哈哈，如果我们戒酒，Yuri会很高兴。反正她总因为喝酒的事训斥我们。

source: *sigh* It is difficult to relax for a drink when she’s upset with us.
translation: *叹气* 她生我们的气时，确实很难放松下来喝酒。

source: Hehe, have a couple more of those, and you'll be too "relaxed" to let her bug you!
translation: 嘿嘿，再喝几瓶，你就会“放松”得根本不在乎她烦你了！

source: Hmph, you think something like this is enough to affect me? I drink much stronger alcohol, you know.
translation: 哼，你觉得这种东西足以影响我吗？你知道，我喝的酒要烈得多。

source: That’s true! I’ve seen how much you were able to put down before! I think those muscles play a big role in it, also~
translation: 这倒是真的！我见识过你以前能喝下多少！我觉得那身肌肉也起了很大作用～

source: Your jacked bod is way tougher than a few beers!
translation: 你那强壮的身体可比几瓶啤酒厉害多了！

source: You and Yoshinori as well. I mentioned it earlier, but it’s amazing to see how much the two of you have bulked up over the recent years.
translation: 你和Yoshinori也是。我之前提过，看到你们两个这些年练得如此壮实，真的很惊人。

source: I understand how Aiden did it, since I see him working out pretty regularly. But I wasn’t aware that you trained as well, Yoshinori.
translation: Aiden是怎么练出来的，我能理解，毕竟经常看见他锻炼。但我不知道你也在训练，Yoshinori。

source: Haha, I have joined Aiden for a few of his workout sessions. But I do try and keep myself in the best shape possible so that I have no issues with our activities!
translation: 哈哈，我参加过几次Aiden的训练。不过我确实会尽量让自己保持最佳状态，这样参与活动时就不会有问题！

source: We are an outdoor-themed camp, after all!
translation: 毕竟我们是一座以户外活动为主题的营地！

source: Tsk, tsk, there you go, bringing it back to work, Yoshi! Come on, let the beers loosen you up too!
translation: 啧啧，Yoshi，你又把话题扯回工作了！拜托，也让啤酒帮你放松一下！

source: A-Ah…
translation: 啊、啊……

source: Aiden's right. Besides, it's not often we get to hang out together like this.
translation: Aiden说得对。况且，我们很少有机会像这样一起消磨时间。

source: Yeah, you guys are right…!
translation: 是啊，你们说得对……！

source: We should do this more often while it’s still off-season! Who knows, maybe one of these days I'll get to see what kind of drunk Gramps is!
translation: 趁现在还是休营期，我们应该经常这样聚一聚！说不定哪一天，我还能看看Gramps喝醉后是什么样！

source: Now that you mention it, I’ve only ever seen Sir Goro drunk once.
translation: 说起来，我也只见过Goro先生喝醉一次。

source: *ehem* That’s classified information, Yoshinori.
translation: *清嗓子* 那是机密信息，Yoshinori。

source: I know Yoshi gets really crazy when he's had too much to drink!
translation: 我知道Yoshi喝多以后会变得特别疯狂！

source: A-Aiden…!
translation: 艾、Aiden……！

source: Hehe~ I’m just kidding, Yoshi~
translation: 嘿嘿～我只是开玩笑，Yoshi～

source: But really, thank you both for giving me a different perspective about this off-season.
translation: 不过说真的，谢谢你们两个让我用不同的角度看待这个休营期。

source: Now I have something to look forward to while the scouts aren’t here…
translation: 现在，童军们不在的时候，我也有值得期待的事情了……

source: Now I have something to look forward to while the scouts aren’t here…{fast}
translation: 现在，童军们不在的时候，我也有值得期待的事情了……{fast}

source: Experiencing new things together.
translation: 一起体验新事物。

source: I want to experience new things together – with the people I truly care about!
translation: 我想和自己真正关心的人一起体验新事物！

source: Now that’s what I’m talking about! It’s about time we got you back, Yoshi!
translation: 这才是我想听的！Yoshi，是时候让从前的你回来了！

source: If we can give the scouts unforgettable memories at camp, there’s no reason we can’t do that for ourselves too!
translation: 既然我们能给童军们留下难忘的营地回忆，当然也能为自己创造这样的回忆！

source: That’s right, Aiden! It’s never too late to explore what the future has in store for us!
translation: 没错，Aiden！探索未来为我们准备了什么，永远都不算晚！

source: And there’s no one I’d rather share it with than you guys!
translation: 而我最想与之分享的人，就是你们！

source: Strengthen our bonds even more than before.
translation: 让我们的羁绊比过去更加深厚。

source: I want to strengthen the bonds between us all, even more than before.
translation: 我想让我们所有人之间的羁绊变得比过去更加深厚。

source: Now that’s something I’m totally on board with!
translation: 这个主意我完全赞成！

source: We shouldn’t miss this chance to spend as much time as we can together!
translation: 我们不该错过这个机会，应该尽可能多地相处！

source: You’re right, Aiden! We were all close before, but that doesn't mean there's not room for more!
translation: 你说得对，Aiden！我们以前就很亲近，但这不代表彼此不能变得更加亲密！

source: Cherishing every moment with my family at camp.
translation: 珍惜和营地家人共度的每一刻。

source: I’ve been looking far ahead into the future instead of cherishing what’s right in front of me – my family at Camp Buddy.
translation: 我一直只顾遥望很远的未来，却没有珍惜眼前的一切——我在 Camp Buddy 的家人。

source: That is something I desire as well.
translation: 这也是我所渴望的。

source: Our time together last summer was a nice reminder of what it was once like, but now is an even better opportunity to get to know one another again.
translation: 去年夏天共同度过的时光，让我们重温了从前的感觉；而现在更是重新了解彼此的绝佳机会。

source: I agree, sir…! Nothing is more important to me than all of you!
translation: 我同意，先生……！对我来说，没有任何事比你们所有人更重要！

source: Rediscovering what this place means to me.
translation: 重新发现这里对我的意义。

source: I want to rediscover what Camp Buddy really means to me!
translation: 我想重新发现 Camp Buddy 对我真正意味着什么！

source: That’s an admirable goal, Yoshinori. Looking back where we came from is a reminder of why we pursued this path.
translation: 这是个值得钦佩的目标，Yoshinori。回顾来时的道路，能提醒我们当初为什么选择这条路。

source: You can count on me to do my best and be there every step of the way.
translation: 你可以相信，我会尽全力陪你走过每一步。

source: Thank you, sir…! I know the past will help guide us to a better version of ourselves for the future!
translation: 谢谢您，先生……！我知道，过去会指引我们在未来成为更好的自己！

source: And with you guys by my side, I’m sure I can take on the challenge, no matter what!
translation: 只要你们陪在身边，无论发生什么，我都有信心迎接挑战！

source: Okay, now I’m convinced the drinks really are going to your head.
translation: 好吧，现在我确定酒劲真的上头了。

source: You always were a sappy drunk, Yoshi!
translation: Yoshi，你喝醉后一直都这么多愁善感！

source: They are not! And I am not!
translation: 才没有上头！我也不是！

source: Haha, you do look a tad red, Yoshinori.
translation: 哈哈，你的脸确实有点红，Yoshinori。

source: Wh-What? You think so too, Sir Goro?!
translation: 什、什么？连您也这么觉得吗，Goro先生？！

source: {i}(Walking back to Camp Buddy with Aiden and Sir Goro under the starry night sky made me remember some of the fond memories I had with them from back when I was a scout.){/i}
translation: {i}（在繁星点点的夜空下，与Aiden和Goro先生一起走回 Camp Buddy，让我想起了自己还是童军时与他们共同留下的一些美好回忆。）{/i}

source: {i}(We’ve all stayed here and done the best we could for the same reason, but the time has come to continue where our own stories left off.){/i}
translation: {i}（我们都因为同样的理由留在这里，并尽了最大的努力；但现在，是时候续写我们各自曾经中断的故事了。）{/i}

source: {i}(This season marks another chance for us to make just as many amazing memories as we had before!){/i}
translation: {i}（这个季节给了我们又一次机会，去创造和过去一样多的精彩回忆！）{/i}
